meta.name: socratic-learning
meta.description: Facilitates deep, structured learning of a topic — gathering source material, assessing the learner's gaps, then teaching through guided Socratic sessions. Use when someone wants to genuinely study or be tutored on a subject over time, not get a quick answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过苏格拉底式对话系统学习任何主题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想通过提问引导深入理解某个领域
copy.tagline_en: Learn any topic systematically through Socratic dialogue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to deeply understand a subject through guided questions

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你进行深度学习：先收集学习资料，评估你的知识缺口，然后通过苏格拉底式提问来教学，而不是直接告诉你答案。
howto.when: 当你表明想长期、系统地学习某个主题（而非快速获取答案）时触发。例如你说“我想学习X”或用类似请求开启对话。

say.text: 我想学习量子力学的基础知识。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集资料并评估你的当前水平。

say.text: 请用苏格拉底法教我经济学中的供需原理。
say.note: Claude 会通过提问引导你思考，而不是直接解释。

say.text: 帮我评估我对Python的了解程度。
say.note: Claude 会设计测试题来找出你的知识缺口。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude becomes a Socratic tutor: it gathers learning materials, assesses your knowledge gaps, then teaches by asking questions rather than giving answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you express a desire to genuinely study or be tutored on a subject over time (not a quick answer), e.g., by saying "I want to learn X" or similar.

say_en.text: I want to learn the basics of quantum mechanics.
say_en.note: Claude starts by gathering materials and assessing your level.

say_en.text: Teach me supply and demand in economics using the Socratic method.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through questions instead of lecturing.

say_en.text: Assess my current knowledge of Python.
say_en.note: Claude designs diagnostic questions to find gaps.
